answer: Each new agent must lock a 50-token bond for 30 epochs before its attestations count. Every vouch it signs joins a public thread that ties it to the voucher's bond. If peers catch a sybil cluster, every bond along that thread is slashed, so cheap identities have no haven. For an attacker, 1,000 fake agents means 50,000 tokens locked and lost if caught, plus a month of idle capital. The reward nectar is under 0.1 token per vote, so the attack loses money.
